codeReview.summary: The feature added useful smoke assertions for the Docker-first scaffold, but it no longer fully covers the feature contract because the reviewed tests are stale relative to the current scaffold and miss a validator-facing service check that the feature claims to lock in.

issues.description: The feature's web smoke test hard-codes the original baseline shell copy instead of validating the validator-facing service contract. The current app renders a different local-first dashboard, so this test would now fail and the feature no longer provides durable smoke coverage for the web service behavior it was supposed to lock in.

The shared smoke test asserts the old `webShellCards` scaffold titles, but the current web surface no longer consumes that contract. Because the feature promised to improve milestone traceability to actual delivered smoke-validation work, this stale test no longer tracks the delivered platform behavior and would fail against the current repository state.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker relied on web-shell copy and shared placeholder cards as the proxy for validator-facing web service coverage, but the repo later moved to a different local-first dashboard contract. There is no shared-state note capturing which UI/API strings are intentionally stable validator contracts versus feature-level copy that can evolve.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Reviewed feature tests target `Baseline shell for the modular monorepo` and `webShellCards` titles in `apps/web/src/App.test.tsx:15-18` and `packages/shared/src/platform.test.ts:12-18`, while the current implementation renders `Workflow dashboard` and no longer uses `webShellCards` in `apps/web/src/App.tsx`.

summary: Fail: the original smoke-coverage commit was valid when landed, but the feature no longer satisfies its contract in the current codebase because two reviewed smoke tests are stale and no longer match the actual validator-facing web platform behavior.
